d: Long, flowing platinum blonde hair with straight-cut bangs and two small braided locks framing the face, topped with a large blue bow and a small gold crown. Large, bright sky-blue eyes with a cheerful, youthful expression on a face with the apparent age of a young child. A slender, petite build wearing a white and blue sleeveless tunic with gold trim, a blue waist sash with gold accents, blue leggings, and white calf-high boots with gold detailing. Accessories include gold bracelets on both wrists and a small blue gemstone pendant around the neck.
